steps.title: Boil the syrup
steps.body: Mix and bring to boil: **2 cups sugar**, **½ cup water** and **1 cup light corn syrup**.

steps.title: Cook to thread
steps.body: Cook til thread when dropped from spoon.

steps.title: Add the flavorings
steps.body: Remove from heat and add: **1 Tbsp butter**, **1 tsp salt**, **2 tsp vanilla** and **2 tsp baking soda**.
